title: Real tenant authorisation and the cost fixes, before any outside tenant
description:
Why: tenancy today is a convention ("This is scoping, not authorization", docs/multi-tenancy.md). AppSync rules grant by Cognito group, never by tenant; References and corpora have no isolation; editors can write all of media/*. Cost also multiplies by tenant count: the whole-corpus home snapshot (PPY-ee02b8, about 55,000 AppSync requests an hour on MoM), the reader snapshot's full read, ReferenceIntake's whole-table list and CloudFront invalidations. No paying stranger goes on the shared tier until this epic is done. Ends with a p.apyr.us page.
Existing, linked: PPY-7f1e54 (index-backed public blocks), PPY-ee02b8 (snapshot and intake scans), PPY-409932 (cache strategy). Do not duplicate them.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Workstream (a), tenant identity and isolation, is planned as tasks PPY-9f3de0 (spike, 3 days, decides the rule form), PPY-0bb0fd (session tenant as role claims), PPY-06ae68 (tenant rules beside group rules), PPY-7dc463 (functions take the tenant from the caller), PPY-98eaee, PPY-203ce2, PPY-baa75d, PPY-e01d82, PPY-29f730 (adversarial suite) and PPY-bdc4ee (group rules removed: the breaking step). The cost-fix half of this epic is tracked by PPY-7f1e54, PPY-ee02b8, PPY-3fd0aa and the fair queue PPY-994bd0.

Verified gaps beyond the memo (develop 23fabe1d): functions get their tenant from a build variable (amplify/site-backend.ts 471-491), and schema-level allow.resource grants give each function every model; Published* models allow guest AppSync reads; Reference, Message and MessageThread have realtime subscriptions on; the projection lease is keyed by bucket name; six DynamoDB tables outside AppSync and the S3 Vectors index have no tenant in their keys; 55 of 60 models lack tenantId (the memo named three).
